name: CI

on:

    branches: [main]

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: pip install ruff
      - run: ruff check .
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: python -m pip wheel . -w dist
  deploy:
    needs: build
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: ./deploy.sh
  notify:
    needs: deploy
    if: failure()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
